top_signals.title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering
top_signals.summary: The United Kingdom has issued economic sanctions against Cryptomus, a chameleonic cryptocurrency platform that experts say serves as a major conduit for payments related to ransomware, narcotics, darknet markets, fraud and cybercrime services that are helping Russia circumvent existing financial restrictions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Zambia Says Some Copper Sales to China to Be Settled in Yuan
top_signals.summary: Zambia said Chinese buyers of its copper exports will start paying for some of their metal purchases in renminbi from next year, part of a growing move among African nations to use the Chinese currency instead of the dollar.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Souaid: IMF Lebanon Talks Progressing At ‘Good Pace’
top_signals.summary: Lebanese Central Bank Governor Karim Souaid said talks with the IMF are progressing at a good pace. This comes as the country commenced high level negotiations with the Fund on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok. Souaid spoke exclusively to Bloomberg’s Avril Hong on Horizons Middle East & Africa. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: China’s Next Frontier
top_signals.summary: Technology experts Kathleen Curlee and Sam Bresnick argue that China is catching up to the United States in space, commercially and militarily. This poses a threat to U.S. military operations, which rely on space-based capabilities. Washington must invest in space defense and also reduce its reliance on the domain.
